name: passthrough
description: No tool-use injection, no system→user rewrite, no history translation. tools are forwarded to upstream verbatim. Benchmark control baseline: isolates the harness contribution from upstream model capability. Will fail every task that requires tool calls, because no tool-use scaffolding is injected and the raw upstream may not honor the agent's tool schemas — that's the point. See architecture/proxy.md for proxy-side details.
